主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. appointed Calin Rovinescu as a Senior Advisor within its global private equity group on March 22, 2021. Rovinescu, previously President and CEO of Air Canada, will support Brookfield’s private equity group in sourcing and executing global investment opportunities, with a focus on aviation and aerospace. He will also implement operations-oriented value creation across portfolio companies. Cyrus Madon, CEO of Brookfield’s Private Equity Group, praised Rovinescu’s leadership and financial expertise. Rovinescu has a background in corporate development, restructuring, and law. Brookfield Asset Management Inc. is a leading global alternative asset manager with $600 billion in assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power, private equity, and credit.
